measureChildWithMargins.cause: NullPointerException: Attempt to read from field int android.view.ViewGroup$MarginLayoutParams.leftMargin on a null object reference in method void android.view.ViewGroup.measureChildWithMargins(android.view.View, int, int, int, int)
measureChildWithMargins.stack: measureChildWithMargins → FrameLayout.onMeasure → View.measure → … (repeated measureChildWithMargins → FrameLayout.onMeasure cycles)
measureChildWithMargins.root_cause: ViewGroup.measureChildWithMargins receives a child whose MarginLayoutParams is null (getLayoutParams() returned null). This is the adapter's View.getLayoutParams() / ViewGroup.generateLayoutParams() returning null for a view added without explicit layout params (e.g. a child added programmatically with addView(view) without params). Framework fix: ViewGroup.measureChildWithMargins should not NPE when MarginLayoutParams is null; either skip the margin or return zero margins.

LayoutParams_init.cause: NullPointerException: Attempt to read from field int android.view.ViewGroup$LayoutParams.width on a null object reference in method void android.view.ViewGroup$LayoutParams.<init>(android.view.ViewGroup$LayoutParams)
LayoutParams_init.stack: LayoutParams.<init> → MarginLayoutParams.<init> → ConstraintLayout$LayoutParams.<init> → ConstraintLayout.generateLayoutParams → ConstraintLayout.getViewWidget → ConstraintLayout.onViewAdded → ViewGroup.dispatchViewAdded → ViewGroup.addViewInner → … (inflation of layout/fragment_webview.xml line #56)
LayoutParams_init.root_cause: ViewGroup$LayoutParams.<init>(ViewGroup$LayoutParams) receives a null LayoutParams argument (the copy constructor is called with null when generateLayoutParams returns null for a view inflated from XML without explicit layout_width/layout_height, or when the adapter's LayoutInflater produces a view whose LayoutParams are null). Framework fix: ViewGroup$LayoutParams.<init> should not NPE on null source; default to MATCH_PARENT/WRAP_CONTENT.

viewgroup_npe.same_root: Both groups share the same root: the adapter's layout-inflation / layout-params path produces null LayoutParams (or null MarginLayoutParams) for views that should have them. The NPE is a symptom of a null LayoutParams being passed into ViewGroup$LayoutParams.<init> or measureChildWithMargins. A single framework fix in the layout-params construction path (default to MATCH_PARENT/WRAP_CONTENT when LayoutParams is null) would address both groups.
